name: io.github.Ahmed-Manai/docs-rag-mcp
title: Docs RAG
description: Search your own documents (Markdown, text, PDF) with RAG from Claude, Copilot or Cursor.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: ollama (default), openai or azure.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model, or the deployment name for Azure OpenAI. Defaults to nomic-embed-text (Ollama) or text-embedding-3-small (OpenAI).

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Service URL. Required for Azure OpenAI; optional for Ollama (http://localhost:11434) and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for OpenAI or Azure OpenAI. Leave it out for Azure to sign in with Microsoft Entra ID.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may index, separated by ; on Windows or : on macOS and Linux.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the SQLite index file. Defaults to ~/.docs-rag-mcp/index.db.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_SEARCH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: hybrid (default) combines keyword and vector ranking; vector uses vector similarity only.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: true (default) watches indexed folders and indexes changes automatically; false indexes only when index_folder is called.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_RERANK_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. URL of a Cohere-style /rerank endpoint (llama.cpp, Cohere, Jina, vLLM...), such as http://localhost:8012/v1/rerank. Turns on reranking of the best results with a cross-encoder model.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_RERANK_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Reranking model, for rerank services that serve several, such as rerank-v3.5 for Cohere.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_RERANK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the rerank service, sent as a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_RERANK_CANDIDATES
environmentVariables.description: How many of the best results are sent to the reranker, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

environmentVariables.name: DOCSRAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: How long a rerank call may take, in seconds, before the normal ranking is used instead. Must be at least 1. Defaults to 30.
